name: Bulbasaur
description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth.

name: Ivysaur
description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy.

name: Charmander
description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force.

name: Charmeleon
description: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry it close to an altitude of 4,600 feet.

name: Squirtle
description: It withdraws into its shell when it feels threatened.

name: Wartortle
description: Its furry tail stores air for swimming underwater.

name: Blastoise
description: The water jets on its shell can accurately shoot targets from a great distance.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet have suction pads that enable it to climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Its shell is soft immediately after it molts, but it soon hardens.

name: Butterfree
description: It loves to gather honey from flowers and carries it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
description: Its poison stinger is very dangerous. It uses its sharp horn to protect itself.

name: Kakuna
description: While waiting for evolution, it hides from predators by attaching itself to trees.

name: Beedrill
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its body and attacks with great speed.

name: Pidgey
description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict, but it can become fierce when threatened.

name: Pidgeotto
description: It has outstanding vision and can spot prey from great distances.

name: Pidgeot
description: Its powerful wings allow it to fly at great speeds and create strong gusts of wind.

name: Rattata
description: Its incisors grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard objects to keep them sharp.

name: Raticate
description: Its sharp fangs can cut through nearly anything, and its whiskers help it keep its balance.

name: Spearow
description: It has a high-pitched cry and can be seen flying rapidly over grasslands.

name: Fearow
description: It has been around for many years and is recognized by its long beak and wings.

name: Ekans
description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. It can swallow prey whole.

name: Arbok
description: The patterns on its hood differ by region and are said to intimidate its enemies.

name: Pikachu
description: It can store electricity in its cheeks and release powerful electric shocks.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail acts as a grounding point that protects it from its own electrical power.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows deep underground and curls into a ball when threatened.

name: Sandslash
description: Its claws and spikes allow it to climb trees and defend itself from attackers.

name: Nidoran♀
description: Although small, its venomous barbs make it dangerous. It uses its ears to sense danger.

name: Nidorina
description: It is cautious and usually avoids fighting, but its sharp claws can be used when necessary.

name: Nidoqueen
description: Its hard scales provide strong protection, and it uses its powerful body to defend its young.

name: Nidoran♂
description: It uses its large ears to check its surroundings and its poisonous horn to defend itself.

name: Nidorino
description: Its horn is harder than a diamond and can inject powerful venom into its opponents.

name: Nidoking
description: Its muscular body is covered with powerful scales, and its horn can inject a strong poison.

name: Clefairy
description: It is said to come from the moon and is often seen dancing under the light of a full moon.

name: Clefable
description: Its hearing is so sensitive that it can hear a pin drop from more than a kilometer away.

name: Vulpix
description: It is born with one white tail that splits into six tails as it grows.

name: Ninetales
description: It is said to live for a thousand years, and each of its nine tails has a special power.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Its soothing voice can lull listeners into a deep sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Its body is soft and rubbery, allowing it to inflate itself by inhaling air.

name: Zubat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves to navigate through dark places because it cannot see.

name: Golbat
description: It attacks prey with its sharp fangs and drinks their blood.

name: Oddish
description: During the day it stays buried in the ground, absorbing nutrients from the soil.

name: Gloom
description: The fluid that drips from its mouth has a powerful and unpleasant smell.

name: Vileplume
description: Its large flower releases clouds of pollen that can cause strong allergic reactions.

name: Paras
description: Mushrooms grow on its back and draw nutrients from its host.

name: Parasect
description: The mushroom on its back has taken over its body and controls its movements.

name: Venonat
description: Its large eyes can detect tiny creatures even in darkness.

name: Venomoth
description: Its wings are covered in scales that can release poisonous powder when disturbed.

name: Diglett
description: It lives underground and leaves raised earth behind as it digs through the soil.

name: Dugtrio
description: Three Diglett work together as one unit, digging powerful tunnels through the ground.

name: Meowth
description: It loves shiny objects and often wanders at night looking for something to collect.

name: Persian
description: Its sleek body and sharp claws make it an agile and dangerous hunter.

name: Psyduck
description: It often suffers from headaches and sometimes unleashes mysterious psychic powers when the pain becomes severe.

name: Golduck
description: Its streamlined body allows it to swim extremely quickly through water.

name: Mankey
description: It becomes extremely angry over small things and can quickly lose control of its temper.

name: Primeape
description: It becomes so enraged that it will chase its target relentlessly until it finally calms down.

name: Growlithe
description: It is loyal and brave, often protecting its territory and trainer with great courage.

name: Arcanine
description: Its majestic appearance and powerful speed have made it famous in legends.

name: Poliwag
description: Its thin skin reveals the spiral-shaped organs inside its body.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Its smooth skin makes it difficult to grab, while the spiral pattern on its belly can mesmerize foes.

name: Poliwrath
description: Its powerful muscles allow it to swim great distances and fight with incredible strength.

name: Abra
description: It sleeps for most of the day and uses its psychic powers to teleport when threatened.

name: Kadabra
description: Its powerful psychic abilities cause strange events to happen around it.

name: Alakazam
description: Its incredible intelligence allows it to remember everything it experiences and solve complex problems.

name: Machop
description: It trains constantly to become stronger and can easily lift heavy objects despite its small size.

name: Machoke
description: Its muscular body is extremely powerful, so it wears a belt to help control its strength.

name: Machamp
description: With four powerful arms, it can deliver many punches at incredible speed.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its flexible body allows it to bend and sway, making it difficult for prey to escape.

name: Weepinbell
description: It catches prey with its vines and dissolves them using digestive fluids.

name: Victreebel
description: It attracts prey with a sweet scent before trapping them inside its large pitcher-shaped body.

name: Tentacool
description: It floats through the ocean and uses its poisonous tentacles to defend itself.

name: Tentacruel
description: Its many tentacles can stretch long distances and release powerful poison.

name: Geodude
description: It lives among rocks and often goes unnoticed because it looks like an ordinary stone.

name: Graveler
description: It rolls down mountainsides without stopping, crushing everything in its path.

name: Golem
description: Its rocky body is extremely durable, allowing it to survive powerful explosions.

name: Ponyta
description: Its fiery mane and tail become stronger as it grows, and it can run incredibly fast.

name: Rapidash
description: It races across open fields at incredible speeds, its mane blazing as it runs.

name: Slowpoke
description: It is very slow and often spends its days sitting beside rivers without noticing its surroundings.

name: Slowbro
description: A Shellder attached to its tail causes it to feel little pain and makes it unusually calm.

name: Magnemite
description: It floats using electromagnetic forces and attacks by releasing powerful electric energy.

name: Magneton
description: Three Magnemite join together to create a powerful magnetic force that can disrupt electronics.

name: Farfetch'd
description: It carries a leek like a weapon and uses it skillfully in battle.

name: Doduo
description: It has two heads that work together to keep watch while it runs across open ground.

name: Dodrio
description: Its three heads allow it to stay alert while running at very high speeds.

name: Seel
description: It prefers cold waters and uses its horn to break through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
description: Its thick body and layer of fat allow it to swim comfortably through freezing waters.

name: Grimer
description: It is made from polluted sludge and leaves a poisonous trail wherever it travels.

name: Muk
description: Its poisonous body is covered in toxic sludge that can damage anything it touches.

name: Shellder
description: Its hard shell protects its soft body, and it closes the shell tightly when threatened.

name: Cloyster
description: Its extremely hard shell protects it from almost any attack, while sharp spikes can launch from its body.

name: Gastly
description: Its body is made almost entirely of gas, allowing it to slip through walls and surround its opponents.

name: Haunter
description: It hides in darkness and can pass through solid objects while searching for unsuspecting prey.

name: Gengar
description: It hides in shadows and enjoys frightening people by appearing suddenly behind them.

name: Onix
description: It burrows through the ground at high speed, leaving behind long tunnels as it searches for food.

name: Drowzee
description: It feeds on dreams and can put people to sleep using its psychic abilities.

name: Hypno
description: It uses a pendulum to put people to sleep and can manipulate their dreams.

name: Krabby
description: It lives near beaches and uses its large pincers to defend itself and catch prey.

name: Kingler
description: Its enormous claw has tremendous crushing power, but its size makes it difficult to move.

name: Voltorb
description: It looks almost exactly like a Poké Ball and is known to suddenly explode when disturbed.

name: Electrode
description: It stores large amounts of electricity inside its body and can suddenly explode after absorbing power.

name: Exeggcute
description: Although it looks like a group of eggs, it is actually a collection of small living creatures working together.

name: Exeggutor
description: Each of its three heads can think independently, but they usually work together as one.

name: Cubone
description: It wears the skull of its deceased mother and carries a bone that it uses as a weapon.

name: Marowak
description: It has become a powerful fighter after learning to use bones as weapons and throwing them with great accuracy.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs can stretch to incredible lengths, allowing it to deliver powerful kicks from a distance.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Its punches are incredibly fast and powerful, allowing it to strike opponents many times in a short moment.

name: Lickitung
description: Its long tongue is covered in sticky saliva and can reach objects several times its own body length.

name: Koffing
description: It floats in the air while releasing poisonous gases from its body when threatened.

name: Weezing
description: Two Koffing joined together to form this Pokémon, allowing it to produce an even stronger poisonous gas.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Its powerful body can charge through almost anything, but it has difficulty changing direction once it starts running.

name: Rhydon
description: Its thick hide protects it from extreme heat, and its powerful horn can destroy solid rock.

name: Chansey
description: Chansey lays nutritious eggs daily. It shares them with injured Pokémon.

name: Tangela
description: Its entire body is covered by thick blue vines that constantly grow and hide its appearance.

name: Kangaskhan
description: It raises its young inside a pouch and becomes extremely protective when its child is threatened.

name: Horsea
description: It lives among seaweed and can shoot powerful jets of water to defend itself.

name: Seadra
description: Its sharp spikes and poisonous body make it dangerous to approach, even though it looks calm.

name: Goldeen
description: Its elegant fins allow it to swim gracefully, but it can become aggressive when defending its territory.

name: Seaking
description: It uses its powerful horn to dig nests and protect its territory during the breeding season.

name: Staryu
description: Its central gem glows brightly at night, and it can regenerate lost parts of its body.

name: Starmie
description: Its mysterious core glows in many colors, especially when Starmie is swimming through the ocean at night.

name: Mr. Mime
description: It is skilled at creating invisible walls with its hands and uses mime-like movements to confuse others.

name: Scyther
description: Its sharp scythes allow it to cut through thick grass with incredible speed.

name: Jynx
description: Its movements resemble dancing, and it communicates through a language that sounds like human speech.

name: Electabuzz
description: It gathers around power plants and absorbs electricity while generating strong electrical sparks.

name: Magmar
description: Its body is constantly surrounded by flames, and it prefers to live near volcanic areas.

name: Pinsir
description: It uses its powerful pincers to grab opponents and can lift objects much heavier than itself.

name: Tauros
description: It becomes enraged when it starts charging and uses its three tails to whip its own body into a frenzy.

name: Magikarp
description: It is a weak swimmer that can barely move against strong currents, but it can eventually evolve into a powerful Pokémon.

name: Gyarados
description: Once it becomes enraged, it can destroy entire areas and rarely stops until everything around it is destroyed.

name: Lapras
description: It is gentle and intelligent, often carrying people across the ocean on its back.

name: Ditto
description: It can transform into almost any Pokémon by copying its opponent's appearance and abilities.

name: Eevee
description: Its unstable genetic structure allows it to evolve into several different forms depending on its environment.

name: Vaporeon
description: Its body has adapted to life in water, allowing it to become almost invisible when swimming.

name: Jolteon
description: Its fur can generate powerful static electricity, which it releases as sharp electric attacks.

name: Flareon
description: It stores inhaled air inside a flame sac and can release fire that reaches extremely high temperatures.

name: Porygon
description: It is a digital Pokémon created by scientists and is capable of moving through cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from a fossil and uses its tentacles to move through the water.

name: Omastar
description: Its powerful tentacles can hold onto prey while its sharp teeth tear through their shells.

name: Kabuto
description: It is an ancient Pokémon restored from a fossil and was once believed to live in shallow seas.

name: Kabutops
description: Its sharp blades were used to cut through prey, and its streamlined body made it an excellent swimmer.

name: Aerodactyl
description: This ancient Pokémon had sharp teeth and powerful wings, allowing it to dominate the skies long ago.

name: Snorlax
description: It spends most of its time sleeping and wakes only when it becomes hungry enough to search for food.

name: Articuno
description: It is said to appear in snowy mountains and can freeze moisture in the air to create ice.

name: Zapdos
description: When it appears during a thunderstorm, it can generate powerful lightning and electricity with its wings.

name: Moltres
description: Its entire body is covered in brilliant flames, and legends say its appearance signals the arrival of spring.

name: Dratini
description: It was once thought to be a mythical Pokémon because it was rarely seen, but it grows steadily by shedding its skin.

name: Dragonair
description: It has a graceful body and can manipulate the weather, making rain or storms appear around it.

name: Dragonite
description: Despite its enormous size and power, it is known to be gentle and capable of rescuing people lost at sea.

name: Mewtwo
description: A Pokémon created through genetic manipulation, it possesses incredible psychic power and intelligence.

name: Mew
description: Mew is said to possess the genetic material of every Pokémon, allowing it to learn almost any move.

name: Sudowoodo
description: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

name: Politoed
description: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

name: Snubbull
description: Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.

name: Granbull
description: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.

name: Scizor
description: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.

name: Sneasel
description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

name: Corsola
description: Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.

name: Skarmory
description: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

name: Porygon2
description: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

name: Smeargle
description: The unique creations produced by each Smeargle are painted using the fluid that oozes from its tail. This is how it marks its territory.

name: Elekid
description: When it’s in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.

name: Magby
description: Many of these Pokémon can be seen in areas with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.

name: Miltank
description: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank’s.

name: Blissey
description: Blissey’s eggs are filled with happiness. It shares them with those who are sad.

name: Treecko
description: It climbs walls with hooked feet and uses its powerful tail in battle.

name: Grovyle
description: Leaves on its body help it blend into forests, where it moves easily through trees.

name: Sceptile
description: It is highly agile in trees and can launch attacks from branches with its sharp leaves.

name: Torchic
description: It follows its Trainer closely and can breathe hot fire despite its small size.

name: Combusken
description: It has grown stronger legs and uses both kicks and flames to fight.

name: Blaziken
description: Its powerful legs let it deliver devastating kicks while generating intense heat.

name: Mudkip
description: The fin on its head senses currents and helps it navigate muddy water.

name: Marshtomp
description: It can move well on land and in water and has a body adapted to muddy terrain.

name: Swampert
description: Its strong arms can move huge boulders, and it can travel through water with ease.

name: Poochyena
description: It is cautious around strangers but becomes fierce when protecting its territory.

name: Mightyena
description: It intimidates foes with a deep growl and can hunt in coordinated groups.

name: Zigzagoon
description: It searches constantly for food and travels by zigzagging across the ground.

name: Linoone
description: It runs in a straight line at high speed and can travel long distances.

name: Wurmple
description: It feeds on leaves and can spray a sticky thread when threatened.

name: Silcoon
description: It forms a protective cocoon while its body prepares for its final form.

name: Beautifly
description: Its brightly colored wings make it a graceful flier that gathers nectar and pollen.

name: Cascoon
description: It wraps itself in silk and waits inside a hardened cocoon as it develops.

name: Dustox
description: It flies mostly at night and can scatter irritating dust from its wings.

name: Lotad
description: It lives on water and uses the broad leaf on its head to float.

name: Lombre
description: It enjoys humid forests and can become active and playful at night.

name: Ludicolo
description: It moves rhythmically and is especially lively when surrounded by music and rain.

name: Seedot
description: It resembles an acorn and hangs from branches until it is ready to move.

name: Nuzleaf
description: It uses its leafy head to sense changes in the air and often hides in forests.

name: Shiftry
description: It can fan strong winds with its leaf-like hands and lives high in trees.

name: Taillow
description: It is a young bird that flies long distances despite its small body.

name: Swellow
description: It is an exceptionally fast flier that can cross great distances without tiring.

name: Wingull
description: Its hollow bones make it light enough to glide on ocean winds.

name: Pelipper
description: Its huge bill can carry food and even protect smaller Pokémon from danger.

name: Ralts
description: It senses the emotions of nearby creatures and is especially sensitive to hostility.

name: Kirlia
description: It dances gracefully and becomes more expressive as its emotions develop.

name: Gardevoir
description: It can read emotions and is said to create small black holes when protecting its Trainer.

name: Surskit
description: It skates across water using the surface tension beneath its tiny feet.

name: Masquerain
description: Eye-like patterns on its antennae can frighten attackers, while its wings allow agile flight.

name: Shroomish
description: It hides in damp places and releases spores when threatened.

name: Breloom
description: It combines powerful punches and kicks with rapid movements from its springy legs.

name: Slakoth
description: It spends most of its time resting and may barely move while lying in the grass.

name: Vigoroth
description: It is constantly active and becomes restless if it is forced to stay still.

name: Slaking
description: It is incredibly strong but spends much of its life sleeping and eating.

name: Nincada
description: It lives underground and uses its claws to dig through soil and roots.

name: Ninjask
description: Its speed is extraordinary, allowing it to move almost too quickly to see.

name: Shedinja
description: It is an empty shell left behind after evolution and survives with a strange protective ability.

name: Whismur
description: Its voice is quiet at first but becomes surprisingly loud when it gets excited.

name: Loudred
description: Its amplified voice can create powerful sound waves that shake nearby objects.

name: Exploud
description: Its roar is so powerful that it can cause vibrations across a wide area.

name: Makuhita
description: It trains constantly and uses its large hands and sturdy body for wrestling attacks.

name: Hariyama
description: Its enormous body is built for grappling and it can throw opponents many times its size.

name: Azurill
description: It loves gentle play and has a soft tail that stores water like a flotation aid.

name: Nosepass
description: Its magnetic nose always points north and can sense subtle changes in magnetism.

name: Skitty
description: It is playful and curious, often chasing anything that catches its attention.

name: Delcatty
description: It has a graceful appearance and a flexible body that can move with ease.

name: Sableye
description: It hides in darkness and collects gemstones, which it prizes as food.

name: Mawile
description: Its large jaws are actually part of its head and can surprise foes from behind.

name: Aron
description: Its metallic body is extremely durable and becomes harder as it grows.

name: Lairon
description: Its armored body can withstand heavy impacts and its jaws are powerful.

name: Aggron
description: It has a body like living armor and can withstand tremendous physical force.

name: Meditite
description: It trains its body and mind through meditation and precise martial arts movements.

name: Medicham
description: It combines meditation with martial arts and can strike with extraordinary precision.

name: Electrike
description: It stores electricity in its fur and becomes energized during storms.

name: Manectric
description: It releases stored electricity in powerful bursts and can generate major shocks.

name: Plusle
description: It gathers electricity from others and cheers for teammates during battles.

name: Minun
description: It absorbs electricity and supports allies by sharing its stored energy.

name: Volbeat
description: It uses glowing patterns to communicate and attract mates at night.

name: Illumise
description: It produces bright signals that help guide Volbeat and can influence their dances.

name: Roselia
description: Its roses release pleasant scents, but its thorns can deliver painful toxins.

name: Gulpin
description: It can swallow almost anything and stores food in its expandable stomach.

name: Swalot
description: Its stomach can dissolve nearly anything and it can produce large amounts of sludge.

name: Carvanha
description: Its sharp teeth make it a dangerous hunter that prefers fast-moving prey.

name: Sharpedo
description: It can swim at tremendous speed and uses its jaws to tear through prey.

name: Wailmer
description: It stores huge amounts of water in its body and can leap from the sea.

name: Wailord
description: It is enormous enough to carry groups of Pokémon on its back across the ocean.

name: Numel
description: Its body contains hot magma, though its slow movements make it look sleepy.

name: Camerupt
description: Magma chambers in its back erupt when it becomes excited or threatened.

name: Torkoal
description: It lives around volcanoes and produces smoke while storing burning coal in its body.

name: Spoink
description: It constantly bounces on its tail because it needs to keep the pearl on its head stable.

name: Grumpig
description: It uses psychic powers to control opponents and can manipulate their emotions.

name: Spinda
description: Its dizzy movements are unpredictable, making its actions difficult to anticipate.

name: Trapinch
description: It burrows into sand and uses powerful jaws to catch prey underground.

name: Vibrava
description: Its wings create vibrations that can induce strange sensations in those nearby.

name: Flygon
description: It flies silently through deserts and can create powerful whirlwinds with its wings.

name: Cacnea
description: It stores water inside its body and can survive long periods without rain.

name: Cacturne
description: It hides in deserts and uses its cactus-like body to ambush prey at night.

name: Swablu
description: Its fluffy cotton-like wings help it float gently through the air.

name: Altaria
description: Its cloudlike wings make it look like a bird made of soft cotton.

name: Zangoose
description: It has sharp claws and a rivalry with Seviper that can lead to fierce battles.

name: Seviper
description: It can use its long body and poisonous fangs to strike suddenly from hiding.

name: Lunatone
description: It floats in the sky and is thought to have come from outer space.

name: Solrock
description: It absorbs sunlight and drifts through the sky using mysterious powers.

name: Barboach
description: It lives in muddy rivers and uses its whiskers to sense movement.

name: Whiscash
description: It can create powerful earthquakes by thrashing its large body.

name: Corphish
description: It is aggressive for its size and uses strong pincers to defend itself.

name: Crawdaunt
description: Its oversized claws are powerful enough to crush hard objects and trap prey.

name: Baltoy
description: It moves by floating and ancient carvings suggest it was made by an old civilization.

name: Claydol
description: It has multiple limbs and can control psychic energy while floating above the ground.

name: Lileep
description: It is a fossil Pokémon that resembles an ancient sea plant and clings to rocks.

name: Cradily
description: It can anchor itself with tentacles and absorb nutrients from the surrounding water.

name: Anorith
description: It is a fossil Pokémon with sturdy claws that once lived in ancient seas.

name: Armaldo
description: Its armored body and large claws make it a powerful hunter from prehistoric times.

name: Feebas
description: It is weak and difficult to find in the wild, but can become beautiful through proper care.

name: Milotic
description: It is known for its beauty and can swim gracefully through both calm and rough water.

name: Castform
description: Its body changes form according to the weather and the conditions around it.

name: Kecleon
description: It can change its color and type to match the move it is about to use.

name: Shuppet
description: It gathers negative feelings in abandoned places and enjoys frightening people.

name: Banette
description: It is a discarded doll animated by resentment and can become intensely vengeful.

name: Duskull
description: It wanders through darkness and is said to appear near people who are about to die.

name: Dusclops
description: It has a hollow body that can absorb spirits and energy from living creatures.

name: Tropius
description: Its large leaves let it fly and its fruit grows from the neck area.

name: Chimecho
description: It floats gently and uses psychic waves to produce a pleasant chiming sound.

name: Absol
description: It is said to sense disasters before they happen and is often blamed for them.

name: Wynaut
description: It is always smiling and uses counterattacks to protect itself from stronger foes.

name: Snorunt
description: It gathers in snowy areas and can withstand extremely cold conditions.

name: Glalie
description: It can freeze moisture in the air and create powerful icy storms.

name: Spheal
description: Its round body rolls easily and it enjoys sliding across ice and snow.

name: Sealeo
description: It plays with round objects and can roll across snowy fields at surprising speed.

name: Walrein
description: Its thick blubber protects it from freezing temperatures and strong attacks.

name: Clamperl
description: It has a hard shell and stores energy inside its pearl-like body.

name: Huntail
description: It swims deep underwater and hunts prey using its long, powerful body.

name: Gorebyss
description: It is a graceful deep-sea Pokémon that uses its delicate appearance to lure prey.

name: Relicanth
description: It is considered a living fossil and can survive for extremely long periods.

name: Luvdisc
description: It is often seen swimming in pairs and is associated with love and romance.

name: Bagon
description: It dreams of growing strong enough to fly and often challenges larger Pokémon.

name: Shelgon
description: Its hard shell protects its developing body while its strength steadily increases.

name: Salamence
description: It can fly at high speed and is known to become more aggressive after gaining wings.

name: Beldum
description: It consists of magnetic cells that communicate with one another through pulses.

name: Metang
description: It uses magnetism to control its metal body and can join with other Beldum.

name: Metagross
description: It is formed from several linked units and possesses immense physical and mental power.

name: Regirock
description: It is made from rock and is said to have been created in ancient times.

name: Regice
description: Its body is made of frozen energy and can survive in extreme cold.

name: Registeel
description: Its steel body is extremely durable and resistant to many forms of damage.

name: Latias
description: It is highly intelligent and can communicate telepathically with people.

name: Latios
description: It is an intelligent flier that uses psychic powers to understand human emotions.

name: Kyogre
description: It rules the sea and is capable of producing enormous storms.

name: Groudon
description: It shaped land according to legend and can unleash devastating sunlight and heat.

name: Rayquaza
description: It lives high above the clouds and is said to calm the battles of Kyogre and Groudon.

name: Jirachi
description: It sleeps for long periods and is said to grant wishes when it awakens.

name: Deoxys
description: It has a DNA-like body and can change its form while adapting its fighting style.

name: Turtwig
description: Its shell is made of earth and it becomes more sturdy as it grows.

name: Grotle
description: It carries small patches of greenery on its shell where Pokémon sometimes rest.

name: Torterra
description: Its shell resembles a small continent, complete with trees and terrain.

name: Chimchar
description: Its fiery tail is fueled by gas in its belly and never goes out.

name: Monferno
description: It uses its fiery tail as a weapon in battle, swinging it to intimidate foes.

name: Infernape
description: Its fighting spirit burns fiercely, and it moves with incredible speed.

name: Piplup
description: Because it is very proud, it dislikes accepting food from people.

name: Prinplup
description: It lives alone, away from others. Each has its own territory.

name: Empoleon
description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power.

name: Starly
description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Staravia
description: They form colonies, but they are territorial and fights break out when they gather.

name: Staraptor
description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

name: Bidoof
description: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.

name: Bibarel
description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as a industrious worker.

name: Kricketot
description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these sounds.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through its body. It can easily raise the voltage of its mane.

name: Luxray
description: It can see through objects. When it spots its prey, Luxray’s eyes glow.

name: Budew
description: Sensitive to changing seasons, Budew’s flower blooms when the weather warms.

name: Roserade
description: Its bouquet is beautiful, but Roserade uses its flowers to poison foes.

name: Cranidos
description: Its hard head is its main weapon. Cranidos headbutts foes with devastating force.

name: Rampardos
description: Its skull is massively thick. Rampardos can knock down almost anything with a headbutt.

name: Shieldon
description: It is thought that Shieldon lived in primeval jungles. It is very protective of its face.

name: Bastiodon
description: Its face is like a wall of iron. Bastiodon defends its young with its massive shield.

name: Burmy
description: To shelter itself from cold, Burmy covers itself with whatever is nearby.

name: Wormadam
description: Wormadam’s cloak changes depending on where it evolved. It is always female.

name: Mothim
description: Mothim is always male. It flutters around at night, attracted to light.

name: Combee
description: Combee gathers nectar and delivers it to Vespiquen. Only female Combee evolve.

name: Vespiquen
description: It houses its colony inside its body and directs Combee to gather honey.

name: Pachirisu
description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It hides them in tree holes.

name: Buizel
description: It has a flotation sac around its neck. Buizel inflates it to keep from drowning.

name: Floatzel
description: It is a strong swimmer. Floatzel carries people or Pokémon on its back while swimming.

name: Cherubi
description: The small ball holds nutrients. Cherubi shares them with its other half during evolution.

name: Cherrim
description: Cherrim blooms in sunlight. Its mood changes with the weather.

name: Shellos
description: Its appearance changes depending on where it lives. Shellos has two forms: East Sea and West Sea.

name: Gastrodon
description: Gastrodon has two forms depending on habitat. Its body is soft and squishy.

name: Ambipom
description: It uses its twin tails to perform dexterous tasks. Ambipom evolved from Aipom.

name: Drifloon
description: Drifloon is said to steal children by grabbing their hands and floating away.

name: Drifblim
description: Drifblim carries people and Pokémon away. It drifts with the wind.

name: Buneary
description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be unrolled and whipped to strike foes.

name: Lopunny
description: Lopunny is very cautious. It fluffs its fur to appear larger when threatened.

name: Mismagius
description: Its cries sound like incantations. Mismagius can cause headaches or hallucinations.

name: Honchkrow
description: Honchkrow is known as the boss of flocks. It commands Murkrow with authority.

name: Glameow
description: It is spiteful and fickle. Glameow will purr to please its trainer, then scratch suddenly.

name: Purugly
description: Purugly binds its waist with its tail to make itself look bigger and more intimidating.

name: Chingling
description: Its cries echo inside its body. Chingling rings like a bell when it is agitated.

name: Stunky
description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Skuntank
description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from its tail. The stench repels even predators.

name: Bronzor
description: Ancient people believed Bronzor was a mirror. Its back is always tarnished.

name: Bronzong
description: It is said to summon rain clouds. Bronzong was revered in ancient times.

name: Bonsly
description: It looks like a tree, but Bonsly prefers dry places. It cries to expel excess moisture.

name: Mime Jr.
description: Mime Jr. mimics foes to confuse them. It evolves when it learns Mimic.

name: Happiny
description: It carries a round stone in its pouch. Happiny is a baby Pokémon that mimics adults.

name: Chatot
description: It mimics human speech. Chatot’s cries sound like songs.

name: Spiritomb
description: It was bound to a fissure in a keystone as punishment for misdeeds.

name: Gible
description: It nests in caves. Gible bites anything that moves.

name: Gabite
description: Gabite hoards shiny objects. It lives in caves and is territorial.

name: Garchomp
description: It flies at sonic speed. Garchomp is feared as a predator.

name: Munchlax
description: It eats anything. Munchlax stores food in its fur.

name: Riolu
description: It understands human emotions. Riolu communicates through aura.

name: Lucario
description: Lucario can sense aura. It understands human speech.

name: Hippopotas
description: It lives in arid places. Hippopotas buries itself in sand.

name: Hippowdon
description: It blasts sand from its body. Hippowdon buries itself in the sand to rest.

name: Skorupi
description: It grips prey with its claws and injects poison. Skorupi hides in sand.

name: Drapion
description: Its body is hard as steel. Drapion’s claws can tear through car metal.

name: Croagunk
description: Croagunk’s cheeks hold poison sacs. It uses them to jab foes.

name: Toxicroak
description: It croaks loudly before attacking. Toxicroak’s poison is potent.

name: Carnivine
description: It attracts prey with sweet-smelling saliva. Carnivine then chomps down.

name: Finneon
description: Finneon’s tail fins shine vividly in the water, attracting prey.

name: Lumineon
description: It lives in the deep sea. Lumineon attracts prey with its glowing fins.

name: Mantyke
description: Mantyke swims with Remoraid attached to it. It evolves when bonded.

name: Snover
description: It lives on snowy mountains. Snover’s berries are a favorite of many Pokémon.

name: Abomasnow
description: It whips up blizzards in mountains. Abomasnow is feared as the Ice Monster.

name: Weavile
description: It lives in cold regions. Weavile hunts in packs.

name: Magnezone
description: Magnezone emits powerful magnetic fields. It evolved in special magnetic areas.

name: Lickilicky
description: Its tongue is over 6 feet long. Lickilicky evolved from Lickitung.

name: Rhyperior
description: It has a drill horn. Rhyperior evolved from Rhydon when traded with a Protector.

name: Tangrowth
description: Its vines grow endlessly. Tangrowth evolved from Tangela when it learned Ancient Power.

name: Electivire
description: It discharges massive amounts of electricity. Electivire evolved from Electabuzz when traded with an Electirizer.

name: Magmortar
description: It blasts fireballs from its arms. Magmortar evolved from Magmar when traded with a Magmarizer.

name: Togekiss
description: It is said to bring blessings to people who are kind and pure of heart.

name: Yanmega
description: Its wings are so powerful they can create shock waves. Yanmega evolved from Yanma.

name: Leafeon
description: Leafeon’s cells are like plants. It performs photosynthesis.

name: Glaceon
description: Glaceon freezes its fur into sharp needles. It evolved from Eevee near ice rocks.

name: Gliscor
description: Gliscor glides silently. It evolved from Gligar when holding a Razor Fang at night.

name: Mamoswine
description: Its tusks are made of ice. Mamoswine evolved from Piloswine when it learned Ancient Power.

name: Porygon-Z
description: It was upgraded with dubious software. Porygon-Z sometimes behaves erratically.

name: Gallade
description: Gallade extends its arms like blades. It evolved from male Kirlia with a Dawn Stone.

name: Probopass
description: It controls mini-noses with magnetism. Probopass evolved from Nosepass in magnetic fields.

name: Dusknoir
description: It is said to take spirits to the afterlife. Dusknoir evolved from Dusclops when traded with a Reaper Cloth.

name: Froslass
description: It freezes foes with icy breath. Froslass evolved from female Snorunt with a Dawn Stone.

name: Rotom
description: Rotom inhabits appliances. It can change forms depending on the device.

name: Uxie
description: Known as the Being of Knowledge. Uxie can erase memories with its eyes.

name: Mesprit
description: Known as the Being of Emotion. Mesprit taught humans the nobility of sorrow and joy.

name: Azelf
description: Known as the Being of Willpower. Azelf gave humans the determination to do things.

name: Dialga
description: It has the power to control time. Dialga is revered as a deity in Sinnoh.

name: Palkia
description: It has the power to control space. Palkia is revered as a deity in Sinnoh.

name: Heatran
description: Its body is made of rugged steel. Heatran dwells in volcanic caves.

name: Regigigas
description: It is said to have towed continents with ropes. Regigigas is the master of the Legendary titans.

name: Giratina
description: It is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. Giratina is a Legendary Pokémon.

name: Cresselia
description: It is said to represent the crescent moon. Cresselia brings pleasant dreams.

name: Phione
description: It drifts in warm seas. Phione is born when Manaphy breeds.

name: Manaphy
description: It is born from a sea egg. Manaphy can bond with any Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
description: It lulls people to sleep and causes nightmares. Darkrai is a Mythical Pokémon.

name: Shaymin
description: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Arceus
description: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

name: Victini
description: It is said that Victini brings victory to any Trainer who befriends it.

name: Snivy
description: It is very intelligent and calm. Snivy photosynthesizes by bathing in sunlight.

name: Servine
description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Servine hides in thick foliage.

name: Serperior
description: It can stop opponents with just a glare. Serperior is regal and commanding.

name: Tepig
description: It blows fire from its snout. Tepig loves to eat roasted berries.

name: Pignite
description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements become quicker.

name: Emboar
description: It can throw fire punches that burn foes. Emboar is very powerful.

name: Oshawott
description: It fights using the scalchop on its belly. Oshawott is brave despite its size.

name: Dewott
description: It trains endlessly with its scalchops. Dewott is disciplined and skilled.

name: Samurott
description: It can unsheathe the seamitars on its legs to fight. Samurott is noble and commanding.

name: Patrat
description: It keeps watch for danger. Patrat warns others with its tail.

name: Watchog
description: It illuminates its body with a special pattern to frighten foes.

name: Lillipup
description: It is very brave despite its small size. Lillipup is loyal to its Trainer.

name: Herdier
description: It is very smart and obedient. Herdier helps Trainers with daily tasks.

name: Stoutland
description: It rescues people stranded in blizzards. Stoutland is very dependable.

name: Purrloin
description: It steals from people for fun. Purrloin pretends to be cute to fool foes.

name: Liepard
description: It is stealthy and fast. Liepard sneaks up on prey without making a sound.

name: Pansage
description: It shares the leaves on its head with others. Pansage is kind-hearted.

name: Simisage
description: It attacks with its thorny tail. Simisage is aggressive and wild.

name: Pansear
description: It stores fire in its tuft. Pansear can roast berries with ease.

name: Simisear
description: It loves sweets. Simisear attacks with flames from its head.

name: Panpour
description: It keeps itself damp by spraying water. Panpour is playful.

name: Simipour
description: It loves playing in water. Simipour sprays water from its tail.

name: Munna
description: It eats dreams and releases mist. Munna is gentle and kind.

name: Musharna
description: It releases mist from its forehead. Musharna shows dreams to others.

name: Pidove
description: It is forgetful and not very smart. Pidove is friendly to people.

name: Tranquill
description: It is calm and collected. Tranquill guides lost people home.

name: Unfezant
description: Males have flamboyant plumage. Unfezant is proud and strong.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. Blitzle runs fast to escape foes.

name: Zebstrika
description: It can generate thunderclouds. Zebstrika is fast and powerful.

name: Roggenrola
description: Its ear is hexagonal. Roggenrola listens for underground vibrations.

name: Boldore
description: Its orange crystals are energy sources. Boldore is sturdy and strong.

name: Gigalith
description: It compresses energy in its body. Gigalith can blast powerful beams.

name: Woobat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves. Woobat leaves heart-shaped marks on walls.

name: Swoobat
description: It emits powerful ultrasonic waves. Swoobat evolved from Woobat through friendship.

name: Drilbur
description: It can dig through the ground at high speed. Drilbur is playful and energetic.

name: Excadrill
description: Its claws can cut through iron. Excadrill is feared for its digging power.

name: Audino
description: It has sensitive hearing. Audino can sense the feelings of others.

name: Timburr
description: It carries a wooden beam. Timburr is strong despite its small size.

name: Gurdurr
description: It carries an iron beam. Gurdurr is skilled at construction work.

name: Conkeldurr
description: It carries concrete pillars. Conkeldurr is skilled at construction and very strong.

name: Tympole
description: It vibrates its cheeks to communicate. Tympole lives in ponds and rivers.

name: Palpitoad
description: It lives in swamps. Palpitoad vibrates its body to communicate.

name: Seismitoad
description: It can vibrate its lumps to produce waves. Seismitoad is powerful and dangerous.

name: Throh
description: It practices throwing techniques. Throh is disciplined and strong.

name: Sawk
description: It trains in martial arts. Sawk is strong and disciplined.

name: Sewaddle
description: It makes clothes from leaves. Sewaddle hides inside them for protection.

name: Swadloon
description: It hides in a cloak of leaves. Swadloon is gloomy but hardworking.

name: Leavanny
description: It makes clothes for small Pokémon. Leavanny is caring and protective.

name: Venipede
description: It attacks with poison stingers. Venipede is aggressive despite its size.

name: Whirlipede
description: It rolls to move quickly. Whirlipede defends itself with its hard shell.

name: Scolipede
description: It charges at foes with its horns. Scolipede is fast and dangerous.

name: Cottonee
description: It drifts on the wind. Cottonee disguises itself as cotton to avoid foes.

name: Whimsicott
description: It rides the wind to travel. Whimsicott sneaks into homes to play tricks.

name: Petilil
description: It prefers moist soil. Petilil’s leaves are bitter but healthy.

name: Lilligant
description: It is admired for its beauty. Lilligant’s flowers bloom with care.

name: Basculin
description: It is very violent. Basculin fights with others of its kind.

name: Sandile
description: It buries itself in sand. Sandile waits for prey to pass by.

name: Krokorok
description: It lives in groups. Krokorok buries itself in sand to ambush prey.

name: Krookodile
description: It is very violent. Krookodile clamps down on prey with powerful jaws.

name: Darumaka
description: It sleeps deeply. Darumaka’s droppings are used as fuel.

name: Darmanitan
description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500°F. Darmanitan is fierce in battle.

name: Maractus
description: It dances rhythmically. Maractus makes sounds like maracas.

name: Dwebble
description: It makes its home in rock shells. Dwebble is resourceful.

name: Crustle
description: It carries a massive rock on its back. Crustle fights fiercely to protect its home.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its loose skin. Scraggy headbutts foes to attack.

name: Scrafty
description: It protects its gang with loyalty. Scrafty is tough and resilient.

name: Sigilyph
description: It is said to guard ancient cities. Sigilyph flies in mysterious patterns.

name: Yamask
description: It carries a mask that used to be its face. Yamask is tied to ancient spirits.

name: Cofagrigus
description: It hides inside a coffin. Cofagrigus swallows those who get too close.

name: Tirtouga
description: It was restored from a fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea millions of years ago.

name: Carracosta
description: It has a sturdy shell. Carracosta can knock out foes with powerful tackles.

name: Archen
description: It was restored from a fossil. Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon.

name: Archeops
description: It is said to be the first bird Pokémon. Archeops is swift and powerful.

name: Trubbish
description: It was created from garbage. Trubbish emits foul gases.

name: Garbodor
description: It sprays toxic gas from its arms. Garbodor is feared for its stench.

name: Zorua
description: It changes its appearance to trick foes. Zorua is mischievous and clever.

name: Zoroark
description: It hides its true form with illusions. Zoroark protects its pack fiercely.

name: Minccino
description: It likes to clean with its tail. Minccino is tidy and energetic.

name: Cinccino
description: Its fur is coated in oil that repels dust. Cinccino is elegant and clean.

name: Gothita
description: It stares intently at things. Gothita is curious and observant.

name: Gothorita
description: It uses starlight to predict the future. Gothorita is mysterious.

name: Gothitelle
description: It can see the future. Gothitelle is said to cry when it foresees a tragic event.

name: Solosis
description: It is surrounded by a special liquid. Solosis communicates telepathically.

name: Duosion
description: Its brain is divided into two. Duosion sometimes has trouble coordinating.

name: Reuniclus
description: It controls arms with psychic power. Reuniclus is very intelligent.

name: Ducklett
description: It paddles around in water. Ducklett is clumsy but cheerful.

name: Swanna
description: It flies gracefully. Swanna leads flocks of Ducklett.

name: Vanillite
description: It looks like ice cream. Vanillite forms from frozen snow clouds.

name: Vanillish
description: It grows larger in blizzards. Vanillish freezes opponents with icy winds.

name: Vanilluxe
description: It produces snowstorms from its two heads. Vanilluxe is feared in blizzards.

name: Deerling
description: Its appearance changes with the seasons. Deerling is gentle and timid.

name: Sawsbuck
description: Its antlers change with the seasons. Sawsbuck is proud and graceful.

name: Emolga
description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Emolga stores electricity in its cheeks.

name: Karrablast
description: It spits acidic fluid to drive away foes. Karrablast dislikes Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
description: It charges with its steel armor. Escavalier is fearless in battle.

name: Foongus
description: It looks like a Poké Ball. Foongus lures prey with its appearance.

name: Amoonguss
description: It lures foes with Poké Ball-like patterns. Amoonguss sprays spores to attack.

name: Frillish
description: It drifts in the sea. Frillish paralyzes prey with its tentacles.

name: Jellicent
description: It drifts in the sea. Jellicent sinks ships and absorbs their crews.

name: Alomomola
description: It heals injured Pokémon. Alomomola wraps them in its special membrane.

name: Joltik
description: It attaches itself to larger Pokémon to absorb static electricity.

name: Galvantula
description: It shoots electrified threads. Galvantula traps prey with sticky webs.

name: Ferroseed
description: It sticks to cave walls. Ferroseed shoots spikes when threatened.

name: Ferrothorn
description: It swings its spikes to attack. Ferrothorn is feared for its defenses.

name: Klink
description: It is made of two gears. Klink rotates to generate energy.

name: Klang
description: Its gears rotate noisily. Klang fights by spinning its gears at high speed.

name: Klinklang
description: Its gears spin at high speed. Klinklang fires energy blasts from its core.

name: Tynamo
description: It forms groups to generate electricity. Tynamo shocks foes with its body.

name: Eelektrik
description: It coils around foes to shock them. Eelektrik is aggressive and strong.

name: Eelektross
description: It crawls out of the ocean using its arms. Eelektross is feared for its strength.

name: Elgyem
description: It appeared from nowhere. Elgyem uses psychic power to communicate.

name: Beheeyem
description: It controls opponents’ minds with psychic power. Beheeyem is mysterious and intelligent.

name: Litwick
description: Its flame is powered by life energy. Litwick guides spirits to the afterlife.

name: Lampent
description: It appears near hospitals. Lampent absorbs souls passing to the afterlife.

name: Chandelure
description: Its flames burn the spirit. Chandelure is feared for consuming souls.

name: Axew
description: It sharpens its tusks on rocks. Axew is playful but strong.

name: Fraxure
description: It fights with its tusks. Fraxure is territorial and fierce.

name: Haxorus
description: Its tusks are incredibly strong. Haxorus is loyal but ferocious in battle.

name: Cubchoo
description: Its nose is always running. Cubchoo uses its mucus to attack.

name: Beartic
description: It freezes its breath to attack. Beartic is powerful and dangerous.

name: Cryogonal
description: It forms from ice crystals. Cryogonal freezes foes with cold air.

name: Shelmet
description: It hides in its shell. Shelmet sprays acid to repel attackers.

name: Accelgor
description: It moves at incredible speed. Accelgor abandons its shell to become agile.

name: Stunfisk
description: It lies flat in the mud. Stunfisk shocks foes with electricity when stepped on.

name: Mienfoo
description: It practices martial arts. Mienfoo strikes opponents with precise movements.

name: Mienshao
description: It uses its long arms like whips. Mienshao is swift and deadly.

name: Druddigon
description: It lives in caves. Druddigon chases prey and bites with sharp fangs.

name: Golett
description: It was created by ancient people. Golett runs on mysterious energy.

name: Golurk
description: It was created to protect people. Golurk can fly despite its size.

name: Pawniard
description: It fights in groups. Pawniard attacks prey with sharp blades.

name: Bisharp
description: It commands groups of Pawniard. Bisharp is ruthless and disciplined.

name: Bouffalant
description: It charges with its afro-like horns. Bouffalant is powerful and wild.

name: Rufflet
description: It is courageous and never backs down. Rufflet trains by fighting constantly.

name: Braviary
description: It is a symbol of bravery. Braviary fights valiantly to protect its allies.

name: Vullaby
description: It wears bones as armor. Vullaby is tough despite being young.

name: Mandibuzz
description: It adorns itself with bones. Mandibuzz circles skies searching for carrion.

name: Heatmor
description: It feeds on Durant. Heatmor uses its tongue to melt through their steel bodies.

name: Durant
description: It lives in colonies. Durant digs tunnels and defends against Heatmor.

name: Deino
description: It is blind and bites everything. Deino is always hungry and aggressive.

name: Zweilous
description: It has two heads that fight each other. Zweilous is violent and gluttonous.

name: Hydreigon
description: It has three heads. Hydreigon is violent and destroys everything in its path.

name: Larvesta
description: It scatters fire from its horns. Larvesta is born in volcanoes.

name: Volcarona
description: It scatters burning scales. Volcarona replaces the sun when volcanic ash fills the sky.

name: Cobalion
description: It has a body and heart of steel. Cobalion leads the Swords of Justice.

name: Terrakion
description: It charges with great force. Terrakion protects Pokémon from human destruction.

name: Virizion
description: It is graceful and swift. Virizion defends Pokémon with speed and elegance.

name: Tornadus
description: It rides the wind. Tornadus causes storms as it flies.

name: Thundurus
description: It flies through storm clouds. Thundurus hurls thunderbolts to attack.

name: Reshiram
description: It sends flames from its tail. Reshiram burns the world with truth.

name: Zekrom
description: It generates electricity in its tail. Zekrom strikes down foes with ideals.

name: Landorus
description: It fertilizes the land. Landorus is revered as the guardian of fields.

name: Kyurem
description: It is said to be the leftover husk of Reshiram and Zekrom. Kyurem freezes foes with icy breath.

name: Keldeo
description: It is one of the Swords of Justice. Keldeo trains to master its sword-like horn.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies bring joy. Meloetta can change form when it sings.

name: Genesect
description: It is a prehistoric Pokémon revived and modified by Team Plasma. Genesect has a cannon on its back.

name: Charizard-Y
description: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
